_doc: Every folder of the Fallout Universe KML, imported whole on the owner's ruling of 2026-08-09. The source is a Google My Maps export and is therefore ALREADY WGS84: no projection was recovered and no residual exists, which is what makes it the most reliable geometry in this project. Rebuild with tools/kml-import-all.py.
creator: u/Sparky_321, extending the original by u/MarcelusWalrus

dedicatedRenderers.why: These complete-import files are canonical, but their features are not drawn through the generic KML layers. Routes and regions feed classified smoothed roads, named wasteland regions and radiation treatment; pre-war states have their own off-by-default control. Drawing the generic layers too would double the geometry and discard those semantics.

canonTags.canon: treat as the map's own canon
canonTags.contested: beta and unreleased material. Imported whole and OFF by default on the owner's ruling, so it can be discounted in one click rather than being absent with no trace of the decision
canonTags.prewar-world: pre-war world geography, outside the continental scope. Same ruling, same treatment: present, labelled, off
canonTags.tv-era: television-era claims, which the community thread this project recorded shows are genuinely disputed - so the map must be able to hold them WITHOUT asserting them
